verdict.rationale: The official docs say that signing in to your Google Account on a new device automatically syncs your codes to it. For users without an account, a guided QR transfer works: create a QR code on the old device, then tap Scan QR code on the new one. Community users confirm the QR export can bundle all codes into one QR code for re-import. Missing for 10: the one-step sync only covers codes saved to a Google Account (offline-only users must use the manual QR flow), tokens are not included in the phone's OS backup, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of the account-sync migration.
